scope: CNC machining for hobbyists and professionals: CNC routers, mills, lathes, plasma cutters and laser cutters, plus the firmware, control software, CAD/CAM, tooling, techniques, learning material and communities around them. General 3D and CAD model libraries are in scope for the "3D & CAD Model Libraries" section, where people search for jigs, fixtures and parts to machine. Out of scope: general 3D printing (unless it is CNC-relevant), generic maker content with no CNC angle, individual product listings from online marketplaces, affiliate links, and link shorteners.
